newsitem.title: USA: Altron sees Q2 revs, earnings below views.
newsitem.headline: Altron sees Q2 revs, earnings below views.

text.p: Altron Inc said Tuesday its revenues and earnings will fall below expectations for the second quarter, which ended June 28.
Sales for the quarter were about $40.5 million and earnings are expected to be about $0.22 per share, it said.
Analysts' consensus estimate for the quarter was $0.29 per share, according to First Call.
The company said lower than expected demand at the end of the quarter, as well as late deliveries of critical materials, reduced sales.
The company will release final second quarter results on July 24.

The company also said lower sales volume and higher costs related to its recent expansion impacted profit margins. With the new capacity now in place, the company is focusing on building its sales force and expanding its customer base.
